meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品网址或一段文案变成产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有产品要上线,需要一条宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product to launch and need a promo video

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简要说明，做成产品发布/宣传视频：先抓取网站素材和品牌色，再定设计系统、写分镜与脚本，逐帧搭建后渲染成 MP4。覆盖 SaaS 推广、功能发布、产品演示等类型。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布宣传或展示某个产品时触发，商业网址默认走这条路线；网站导览/展示类需求也归这里。意图不明时先读 /hyperframes 做路由。

say.text: 用我们官网的网址做一条产品宣传视频
say.note: 先抓取网站素材，再走分镜到渲染

say.text: 把这个脚本做成 30 秒的发布视频，旁白照原稿念
做一条网站导览视频，页面按实际截图展示
say.note: 用真实截图作视觉基准，不重搭整页

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, a pasted script, or a brief into a product launch or promo video: it captures the site and brand colors, sets a design system, writes a storyboard and script, builds frames, then renders an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; a commercial URL defaults here, and site tours or showcases route here too. Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a promo video from our website URL
say_en.note: Captures the site, then storyboard to render
